Name: Period of Service ID
Description: The surrogate ID for the period of service. Only available when updating existing records.

Name: Legal Employer
Description: The name of the legal entity for this work relationship.

Name: Person Number
Description: The person number of the person this work relationship is for.

Name: Start Date
Description: The start date of the period of employment.

Name: Worker Type
Description: Specifies whether the period of service is for an employee, contingent worker, pending worker, or nonworker.

Name: Person ID
Description: A unique reference to the person this work relationship is for.

Name: Action Code
Description: The action being performed for this period of service record, such as Hire, Add Pending Worker, or Add Contingent Worker.

Name: Actual Termination Date
Description: The last date of employment for this period of service.

Name: Cancel Work Relationship
Description: A work relationship can be canceled by supplying a value of Y when using the DELETE instruction.

Name: Comments
Description: Comments entered by the user in a termination.

Name: Correct Termination
Description: To correct the termination date for a terminated work relationship, supply a value of Y and provide the new termination date using the ActualTerminationDate attribute.

Name: Date for Primary Work Relationship Change
Description: To make a nonprimary work relationship primary, you supply only the work relationship that is to be made primary with the PrimaryFlag attribute set to Y. Provide the date from when the work relationship is to be primary on the DateForPrimaryFlagChange attribute. The corresponding changes to employment terms and assignment are maintained automatically. The primary relationship indicator for the existing primary work relationship is set to N automatically.

Name: Date of Death
Description: The date of death.

Name: Enterprise Seniority Date
Description: The original date of hire. The enterprise seniority date is the start date of a person's primary work relationship by default. This date can be updated only for the Primary Work Relationship. Any change applies automatically to all of the person's work relationships that had the same enterprise seniority date before the update. If you are using V3 of the seniority dates feature, you cannot update this date using HCM Data Loader.

Name: Global Transfer
Description: Indicates whether to perform a global transfer.

Name: Hide Until Date
Description: The date until when the termination is to be hidden.

Name: Last Working Date
Description: The last working date.

Name: Legal Employer Seniority Date
Description: The adjusted service date. If this date is left blank, it is assumed to be the same as the start or hire date of the work relationship with that legal employer. If you are using V3 of the seniority dates feature, you cannot update this date using HCM Data Loader.

Name: Legal Entity ID
Description: A unique reference to the legal entity for this work relationship.

Name: New Start Date
Description: To change the hire date for an existing work relationship, supply the new hire date. Do not supply the employment terms or assignment records.

Name: Notified Termination Date
Description: The date on which termination was notified.

Name: On Military Service
Description: Indicates whether the person is on military service.

Name: Primary Employment
Description: Specify Y if this is the primary employment period for the legal entity.

Name: Projected Termination Date
Description: The projected last date of employment for this period of service.

Name: Ready To Convert
Description: Indicates whether the pending worker is ready to be converted to the proposed worker type.

Name: Reason Code
Description: The reason for the action being performed.

Name: Recommendation Authorized by Person ID
Description: A unique reference to the person who recommended that this worker not be rehired.

Name: Recommendation Authorized by Person Number
Description: The person number of the person who authorized that this worker cannot be rehired.

Name: Recommendation Reason
Description: The reason for the recommendation that this worker not be rehired.

Name: Rehire Recommendation
Description: Indicates whether the person's rehire is recommended.

Name: Reverse Termination
Description: A terminated work relationship can be reversed by supplying a value of Y.

Name: Revoke User Access
Description: By default the person's user access is removed one day after the termination date. Specify I to request immediate removal of user access.

Name: Terminate Work Relationship
Description: To terminate a work relationship specify a value of Y and provide a date for the ActualTerminationDate attribute.

Name: Worker Comments
Description: Worker comments on resignation.

Name: Worker Number
Description: The worker number, if any, for this work relationship.

Name: Source System ID
Description: A value to uniquely identify this record. This must be unique for the source system owner and business object component.

Name: Source System Owner
Description: The name of the source system used to generate the source system ID.

Name: Globally Unique ID
Description: The globally unique ID. Only available to reference existing records, it cannot be supplied for new records.

Name: Reference Context
Description: The context for the user-defined references provided for this component. Don't supply values for this attribute, instead specify the context against this attribute in the METADATA line using the format: SourceRefTableName= context. For example: SourceRefTableName=Store Information.

You name your reference on the METADATA line using the format Attribute name = Reference name. For example, SourceRef001=Assignment Number.
